notes: Unlike JER.8.5, this verse writes כִּי, so the 'then' of 'why then' is aligned to it rather than added; the unit note records the competing reading.
Both question auxiliaries go to הַ and אִם under rule 17, so each אֵין keeps its supplied dummy 'there' and its negation and heads on 'no' under rule 50.
רֹפֵא takes no supplied determiner of its own, since the phrase's determination is carried by the existential's 'no' — rule 46 supplies English only where the ASV writes it.
עָלְתָה is recast as the passive 'is … recovered', discontinuous across the intervening subject chain (rule 25).
